title: RoomSpec
description: Canonical, engine-agnostic description of ONE experimental room. One spec -> one room. Produced by a human (web wizard) OR an AI agent; consumed by the Unity generator AND the web viewer. Designed for controlled environmental-neuroscience experiments where only one or two variables are manipulated at a time.

spec_version.description: Schema version this spec targets. Lets producers/consumers evolve safely.

room_type.description: Premade room family. Selects the RoomPreset that supplies defaults, the furniture catalog, and the named layout slots.

seed.description: Reproducibility seed for any randomized choice. Same seed + same spec => byte-identical room.

ceiling_height_m.description: Floor-to-ceiling height. A primary independent variable (high vs low ceiling).

contour.description: Wall + opening geometry. Tawil's core manipulation (angular vs curved).

ceiling.description: Ceiling material. Set visible=false to leave the room open-topped (dollhouse view).

openings.description: Doors and windows. Built as gaps in the walls.

position.description: Normalized slide along the wall (0 = left end, 1 = right end).

lighting.description: Illumination mood. Pick a named preset; override warmth/intensity/hdri as needed.

warmth.description: 0 = warm, 1 = cool. Overrides the preset when present.

hdri.description: Environment-map id for image-based lighting, or 'none'.

furniture.description: Items placed in the room. catalog_id MUST exist in the room_type's catalog. Placement is by named slot (preferred) or explicit coordinates.

catalog_id.description: Furniture model id from the room_type catalog, e.g. 'dining_table_6', 'dining_chair'.

placement.description: EITHER a named slot from the preset (preferred), OR explicit metres + rotation.

slot.description: Named anchor from the preset's layout_slots, e.g. 'table_center', 'chair_3', 'long_wall_back'.

z_m.description: Metres from room centre, +z = front (door wall).

material_override.description: Optional. Recolour/retexture this item (e.g. a matched furniture set).

experiment.description: Research metadata. Keeps variation honest and CONTROLLED — only the listed variables may differ from the control.

condition.description: This room's role in the study.

manipulated_variables.description: Dotted paths of the fields that intentionally differ from the control, e.g. ['shell.ceiling_height_m']. EVERYTHING ELSE must be held constant.

pair_id.description: Links a control/treatment pair or set.

provenance.description: Where this spec came from + how the room is realized.

execution_path.description: Honesty label (project convention): live = built now from params; cached = served from the store; regen = needs a backend rebuild; preview_only = approximate stand-in.

tint_hex.description: Optional sRGB tint multiplied over the material.

wall_ref.description: Which wall. front = the door wall (+z), back = opposite (-z), left = -x, right = +x.
